factorisation.kernel: tools/validation/hybrid_fast.FastRoomKernel (compiled; same terms as ref_hybrid.RoomKernel, agreement <= 1e-7 relative, tools/validation/tests/test_hybrid_fast.py)
factorisation.argument: rungs from 1.25 m are computed per case with the air factored out (one band column without air, then exp(-m_b c t) per 1 ms bin); exact for the continuous model when alpha and s do not depend on the band, because every diffuse path's air factor is exp(-m R) with R = c t; the discrete hybrid applies air per whole delay bin, so the two differ by the binning (factorisation_check_2.5)
